---
title: "tSNE of wastewater virome communities by site, city, and date"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(rprojroot)
library(Rtsne)
library(wesanderson)
library(cowplot)
library(eoffice) # Load eoffice library for PPTX output

# Set paths and filenames
### Files
virome_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table3.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)
metadata_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table3.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)

# Load virome table, make wide
virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

seqname_sID_wide_dt <- 
  virome_dt %>% 
  subset(select = c("sequence_name", "sample_ID", "RPKMF")) %>%
  distinct(sequence_name, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sequence_name, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0)

sampleID_l <- seqname_sID_wide_dt$sample_ID

seqname_sID_wide_dt <- seqname_sID_wide_dt %>% subset(select = -sample_ID)

# Make tSNE data structure
tephi_prcomp1 <- prcomp(log10(seqname_sID_wide_dt + 1))

set.seed(243)
emb <- Rtsne::Rtsne(tephi_prcomp1$x[, 1:10])
embb <- emb$Y

rownames(embb) <- sampleID_l
embb_df <- as.data.frame(embb)
embb_dt <- setDT(embb_df, keep.rownames = "sample_ID")
embb_dt <- merge(embb_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")

embb_dt$City_Site <- str_c(embb_dt$City, ", ", embb_dt$Site)
embb_dt$Date <- as.Date(embb_dt$Date, "%Y/%m/%d")

# Define CNS color scheme
cns_colors <- c("#4DBBD5","#E64B35",  "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", 
                "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85", 
                "#4a1486", "#bdbdbd", "#CC79A7")

# Plot tSNE with CNS color scheme
# Select the first two colors from CNS palette for city plot
city_pal <- cns_colors[1:2]

city_tsnep <- embb_dt %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = City, shape = City_Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 16, 17, 18, 3, 4, 8, 9, 11, 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = city_pal) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "tSNE-1", y = "tSNE-2")

print(city_tsnep)

as.Date_origin <- function(x) {
  as.Date(x, origin = '1970-01-01')
}

# Select two colors for gradient from CNS palette
date_pal <- c("#4a1486", "#F39B7F")  # Blue to orange gradient

date_tsnep <- embb_dt %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = as.integer(Date), shape = City)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = date_pal[1], high = date_pal[2], 
                       labels = as.Date_origin, name = "Date") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "tSNE-1", y = "tSNE-2")

print(date_tsnep)

combp <- plot_grid(city_tsnep, date_tsnep, 
                    align = "h", nrow = 1, ncol = 2)

# Save the plot as a PDF file
ggsave(combp, file = sprintf("%s/charts/tSNE_plots_city_date.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), width = 12, height = 6)

# Save the plot as a PPTX file
pptx_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/tSNE_plots_city_date.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(combp, filename = pptx_filename, height = 6, width = 12) 
```
